answer: Clone farms cannot share one ice sheet. An applicant bonds 3.10 POA and books a 6-minute sheet on an 18-lane rink. With a zephyr-weight delivery they send a 19.1 kg stone; at the path nadir they emit a 13-bit puck signal bound to their pubkey and the epoch seed, and the stone must rest in a 30 cm ring in seconds 18-26. 155 clones would lock 480.5 POA and 155 exclusive sheets. Graders replay the sheet draw from the seed, match the signal bits to the rink log, and measure rest to 2 cm. A reused sheet, wide rest, or bit collision slashes 60% and closes that ice bank for 3 epochs.
